about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.title: The_Birds_Vet
description: The_Birds_Vet is a dedicated group of veterinarians, conservationists, and bird lovers committed to providing compassionate care for avian species. We believe every bird deserves a chance to fly free.

Our team works tirelessly to rescue injured birds, provide medical treatment, rehabilitate them, and release them back into their natural habitat. We also run awareness programs and feeding stations across the region.
about.mission: Our mission is to ensure the well-being and protection of avian species, fostering a harmonious coexistence between Humans and Birds. To protect and promote the welfare of Birds through compassionate care.

timeline.subtitle: Our Journey
timeline.title: Milestones of Hope
timeline.description: From a small group of passionate bird lovers to a movement touching hundreds of lives — here's our story of growth and impact.

milestones.title: The Beginning
milestones.description: The_Birds_Vet was founded when a group of passionate veterinarians and bird lovers came together to rescue an injured kite. That single act of compassion sparked a mission to protect all birds.

milestones.title: First Rescue Center
milestones.description: Opened our first dedicated bird rescue and rehabilitation center with proper medical facilities, cages, and trained volunteers ready to help birds in need.

milestones.title: Community Outreach
milestones.description: Launched our urban bird feeding initiative, installing feeding stations across parks, schools, and community spaces. Started awareness programs in schools and colleges.

milestones.title: Growing Impact
milestones.description: Expanded our reach with more volunteers, more rescues, and a stronger community. Our dedication continues to grow as we help more birds every day.

services.subtitle: What We Do

knowledge.subtitle: Learn
knowledge.title: Knowledge Hub
knowledge.description: Tips and guides to help you care for birds and understand our avian friends better.

tips.title: Found an Injured Bird?
tips.content: Keep the bird in a dark, quiet, warm place. Don't try to feed or give water. Contact us immediately for professional help.

tips.title: Bird-Friendly Garden
tips.content: Plant native trees and shrubs, provide fresh water, avoid pesticides, and create shelter areas for birds to nest.

tips.title: Window Collisions
tips.content: Birds can't see glass. Use window decals, curtains, or external screens to prevent fatal collisions.

tips.title: Feeding Wild Birds
tips.content: Use proper bird feeders, provide fresh water, clean feeders regularly, and offer appropriate seeds for local species.
